details:
Q1: How should this issue cover the plan's four phases, given that the plan requires one PR per phase?
Choices:
A. Do all four phases in this issue as one PR, with commits in phase order and one changelog fragment per phase, so each phase can still be rolled back on its own as the plan intends. (RECOMMENDED) Merges of activation-fix issues are not checked again, so a gap left out here would never be re-reported.
B. Do only Phase 1 (overflow lookup off by default, plus the README and default-value doc fixes) in this issue. Phases 2–4 stay open and need separate issues filed by an operator.
C. Do Phases 1 and 2 here (overflow off, and removing the unused bootstrap from clarify, plan, orchestrate and orchestrate_clarify_respond). Phases 3 (lazy bootstrap) and 4 (telemetry) are left for separate issues filed by an operator.
D. Implement nothing here. Re-route the plan through the orchestrator as a four-sub-issue project (one sub-issue per phase) and close this issue in favour of that project.
Assumption: the activation evidence suggests PR #6271 shipped only the plan document and none of its phases, so all four phases are still to do.
